requirements.text: REQ-GIVEN-IN-SUCCEEDS: a given-in swap between two tokens of the pool goes through, for any well-behaved math, when the scaling factor of the token out is positive and the fee is below 100%.

REQ-GIVEN-OUT-SUCCEEDS: a given-out swap between two tokens of the pool goes through, for any well-behaved math, when the exact amount out rounded up is below the pool's balance of that token (both in 18-decimal units), the scaling factor of the token in is positive and the fee is below 100%.

REQ-GIVEN-IN-PAYS-AT-MOST: in a given-in swap the trader receives at most what the math prices the exact amount in, net of the fee, rounded down: `y * rate_out / 1e18` is at most `outGivenIn` of that amount. Rounding never pays out more than the trader paid for.
REQ-GIVEN-IN-PAYS-AT-LEAST: and it receives at least what the math prices one raw unit less than the net amount in, less one raw unit out: the rounding costs the trader at most one unit on each side.

REQ-GIVEN-OUT-CHARGES-AT-LEAST: in a given-out swap the trader is charged, after the fee, at least what the math prices the exact amount out rounded up to a whole 18-decimal unit: `c * (1 - fee) * rate_in / 1e18` is at least `outPrice`. Rounding never lets the trader take more than it pays for.

requirements.text: REQ-GIVEN-OUT-CHARGES-AT-MOST: and one raw unit less than the charge, after the fee, is below that price plus one raw unit of the token in: the rounding costs the trader at most one unit for the conversion back to raw units and one for the fee.
REQ-SWAP-KEEPS-VALUE: for any well-behaved math, a swap that goes through never lowers the pool's value as the pool measures it (`value`).

witness.message: swap of 17 lowered the pool's value from 4750372932 to 2375399004

requirements.text: REQ-BATCH-KEEPS-VALUE: for any well-behaved math, any pool and any batch of swaps of either kind, a batch that goes through never lowers the pool's value as the pool measures it. The rounding of one swap cannot be repeated inside a batch to drain the pool.
